subject: Design + build product e2e bench (DAG+RAG whole process, ON vs OFF, public-bench source)
description: The held-out bench is a gate unit test (RAG only). Build a SECOND, product-level bench: ON (full orchestrator graph+DAG+RAG+gate+workers) vs OFF (plain agent), on context-REQUIRED interdependent tasks. Needs the DAG-dependency analog of a KB-dependent candidate: task B fails without task A's context-edge summary, succeeds with it. Public bench (SWE-bench-style) = realistic/objective-outcome source but single-issue (RAG-heavy, light on DAG) — multi-task scenarios needed for DAG. NEEDS DESIGN before build (what a minimal DAG-required candidate looks like; whether to source from a public bench or hand-author multi-task scenarios). This is how the product's ON-vs-OFF value finally gets measured (vs the parity seen so far).
